title: Portal 2 Costs You $1.18 an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Portal 2 is $9.99 on Steam and takes about 8.5 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat averages, main story): about $1.18 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 22 hours) and it drops to 45¢ an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat averages
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend who still quotes GLaDOS. Portal 2 costs about $1.18 an hour.
